verdict.line: You lose if you walk up to trade autos into Infected Cleaver range before level 6; you win if you farm it out and force all-ins once Fury of the Sands is up.

brief.thesis: Dr. Mundo's Q (Infected Cleaver) is a 975-range skillshot on a 4-second cooldown, so he can poke you for free at a range your 255-range Q (Siphoning Strike) can't answer. But Mundo has no hard disengage besides sacrificing health for Sadism's move speed, so once you have Wither and stacked Q damage, you can run him down in a straight fight — which is exactly why the data shows an even 54.3% head-to-head skewed toward your solo-kill advantage rather than his.

theirWindow.what: He will spam Infected Cleaver from max range to chip you while you're stuck last-hitting. Don't walk forward to answer it — stay on minions, take the Q stacks, and let the poke miss when it can.

yourWindow.what: Land Wither first to decelerate his Movement and Attack Speed, then commit with stacked Siphoning Strike autos. He has no gap-closer and Burning Agony only punishes him, not you, so a slowed Mundo is a dead Mundo.

powerCurve.note: Cleaver poke chips you with no reply
Spirit Fire lets you punish his approach
Fury of the Sands turns all-ins decisive
Trinity Force plus Q stacks win extended trades

start.why: Doran's Shield wins the specific fight here: it blunts the poke-and-regen pattern of Infected Cleaver chip damage, the single biggest threat to your early CS. Run by 65.7% of Nasus players in this matchup at a 59.6% win rate.

boots.why: The ability haste shortens Wither, Spirit Fire, and Siphoning Strike cooldowns, letting you stack faster and keep Wither up more often for forced fights. 61.4% pick rate, 55.6% win rate.

core.why: The on-hit proc damage and move speed let your now-stacked Q autos actually catch and punish a decelerated Mundo instead of just farming minions with it.
Armor and the attack speed slow on nearby enemies blunt his Burning Agony trades and auto-attack damage in extended fights.
Boosts your Soul Eater lifesteal healing against his sustained Burning Agony damage. This exact path wins 56.4% over 39 games.

situational.when: he builds into lifesteal or sustain items that out-heal your poke and trades
his Adrenaline Rush passive regen is outpacing the damage you can land in lane
the game goes long and you need the extra ability haste and mana sustain to keep Wither and Spirit Fire up during split pushes

runes.keystoneWhy: The move speed burst helps you reposition out of Infected Cleaver's throw angle, and the healing-on-hit from last-hitting minions offsets his free poke damage while you're farming stacks.

summoners.why: Teleport is the most-picked spell here (55.6% pick, 53.2% win) because it lets you reset after poke exchanges and come back to lane fresh instead of fighting a losing early trade. Ghost helps you stick onto a Withered Mundo during the all-in window since he has no dash to escape with.

playing.title: Farm from max Q range
playing.detail: Step up only to last-hit with Siphoning Strike, then retreat. Don't trade autos into his 975-range Cleaver before you have Wither and a stack lead.

playing.title: Respect low-health Mundo
playing.detail: Masochism gives him bonus Attack Damage scaling with his missing health, so a Mundo sitting at 20% HP is not a free kill — he hits harder, not softer, there.

playing.title: Wither before you commit
playing.detail: Always land Wither first in any all-in. Its Movement and Attack Speed deceleration is the only thing stopping him from kiting you with Cleavers while you close distance.

playing.title: Zone trades with Spirit Fire
playing.detail: Drop Spirit Fire on the brush or path he has to walk through to engage. The Armor reduction plus the ground damage swings close-range trades toward you.

playing.title: Save Fury of the Sands for the kill window
playing.detail: Fury of the Sands' Health gain and nearby Health drain is best spent on a committed, Withered all-in — not as a defensive panic button, since he has no burst to punish you for using it.

playing.title: Track his Sadism usage
playing.detail: Once he casts Sadism for the Movement Speed and Health Regen, he's choosing to disengage, not fight. Chase with Ghost and Wither rather than trying to out-trade him in that state.

playing.title: Keep fights short with item procs
playing.detail: Once Trinity Force is online, favor quick burst-and-reset trades over standing in Burning Agony's continual damage radius for a long fight.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the ability kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being chased by Dr. Mundo’s Infected Cleavers (Q) early game. Focus on farming with [Q] to gain stacks and growing without fighting.
